# Orion Love, Real Estate Broker (Grand Junction, Colorado)

> Orion Love is a real estate broker with Keller Williams Colorado West Realty who works with home sellers in Grand Junction and across Mesa County, Colorado. Colorado real estate broker license FA.100110841.

- Brokerage: Keller Williams Colorado West Realty
- Office: 2474 Patterson Rd #100, Grand Junction, CO 81505
- Phone: (970) 644-6781
- Email: orion.love.co@gmail.com
- Service area: Grand Junction, Fruita, Palisade, Clifton, the Redlands, Orchard Mesa, Loma, Mack and the rest of Mesa County, Colorado
- Focus: seller representation (pricing, preparation, listing and negotiation); buyer conversations are also welcome
- Background: born in Delta, Colorado; living in the Grand Valley since 2010; nearly ten years building custom cabinetry before real estate
